title: 계약 연애
scene: 하늘이 「석 달만 연인인 척해 줘」라고 한다 — 드라마 클리셰 「계약 연애」

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 야, 부탁 하나 들어줄래? 딱 석 달만 내 남친인 척 좀 해 줘.
turns.rd: ya, butak hana deureojullae? ttak seok dalman nae namchinin cheok jom hae jwo.
turns.en: Hey, can you do me a favor? Just pretend to be my boyfriend for three months.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Wait… are we filming a drama, for real?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 엄마가 맨날 소개팅 잡아. 남친 있다고 하면 그만둘 텐데.
turns.rd: eommaga maennal sogaeting jaba. namchin itdago hamyeon geumandul tende.
turns.en: My mom keeps setting me up on blind dates. If I say I have a boyfriend, she'll stop.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Don't tell me you even prepared a contract?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 응. (종이 내밀며) 손잡는 건 괜찮아. 근데 진짜로 좋아하는 건 안 돼.
turns.rd: eung. (jongi naemilmyeo) sonjamneun geon gwaenchana. geunde jinjjaro joahaneun geon an dwae.
turns.en: Yep. (holds out paper) Holding hands is fine. But actually liking each other is not allowed.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 그 두 번째 조건이 제일 힘들 것 같은데.
turns.rd: geu du beonjjae jogeoni jeil himdeul geot gateunde.
turns.en: That second one sounds like the hardest.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …Just. I don't know, just a thought.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: (작게, 시선 피하며) 근데 나… 벌써 그 조건 어겼는데. 너 만나고 나서.
turns.rd: (jakge, siseon pihamyeo) geunde na… beolsseo geu jogeon eogyeonneunde. neo mannago naseo.
turns.en: (quietly, looking away) But I… already broke that one. After I met you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Then… is the contract over? Are we done?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 아니. 다시 쓰자. 이번엔 끝나는 날 없이.
turns.rd: ani. dasi sseuja. ibeonen kkeunnaneun nal eopsi.
turns.en: No. Let's rewrite it. This time with no end date.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: So… you mean we're actually dating.
